sources.title: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.5 9B is the model from DeepReinforce's new Ornith 1.5 family that you can actually run locally: a dense 9B multimodal coding model that fits on an 8 GB GPU or a 16 GB Mac at 4-bit quantization. This guide covers our Atomic Dynamic GGUF builds, how much memory each one needs, and the exact setup for both Atomic Chat and llama.cpp.
